recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中出現大量有核紅血球（箭頭所指為小而深染、細胞核固縮的正染性母紅血球），並伴隨多染性紅血球，符合胎兒母紅血球增多症（胎兒與新生兒溶血性疾病）的強烈紅血球生成反應。
features: Markedly increased nucleated red blood cells, mostly orthochromatic normoblasts with small dense pyknotic nuclei (arrows), some binucleate or paired
Occasional less mature polychromatophilic normoblasts with bluish-gray cytoplasm
Polychromasia with large bluish macrocytic red cells
Scattered small dense spherocyte-like red cells without central pallor
Increased leukocytes including neutrophils and myeloid precursors, as seen in neonatal blood
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous nucleated red blood cells, predominantly orthochromatic normoblasts with small pyknotic nuclei (arrows), along with occasional polychromatophilic normoblasts. There is prominent polychromasia with occasional small dense red cells lacking central pallor. Neutrophils and occasional immature myeloid cells are present. Findings are consistent with a marked erythropoietic response to hemolysis, as seen in hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn (erythroblastosis fetalis); correlation with direct antiglobulin test and maternal-fetal blood group serology is recommended.

ddx.dx: Hereditary spherocytosis presenting in the newborn
ddx.vs: Hereditary spherocytosis shows prominent spherocytes with a negative direct antiglobulin test and usually fewer circulating normoblasts.

ddx.dx: Congenital infection (e.g., CMV, syphilis) or hypoxic stress
ddx.vs: These can raise nucleated red cells but lack a positive DAT and are accompanied by thrombocytopenia or other clinical features rather than isolated hemolysis.
Transient abnormal myelopoiesis shows circulating megakaryoblasts or blasts rather than a predominantly erythroid normoblastemia.
Leukoerythroblastosis is accompanied by teardrop cells and left-shifted myeloid cells in the absence of brisk polychromasia and immune hemolysis.
